xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-3841: Dashboard button: open a No-Project conversation that reviews recent cross-issue activity and summarizes pipeline problems (retrospective)

plan.title: Dashboard button: open a No-Project conversation that reviews recent cross-issue activity and summarizes pipeline problems (retrospective)
plan.author: agent:claude-fable-5-1

references.label: PAN-3836 (the incident the reference report covers)

narratives.Problem: PAN-3836 needed eight rework cycles; half the delay was pipeline/substrate faults and half was a haiku-tier work agent, but nothing showed that as a whole. Each symptom surfaced separately in feedback files, deacon logs, and review syntheses, and a human conversation spent hours assembling the picture. The operator needs one button that asks 'what went wrong across everything in the last 24 hours (or 7 days)?' and gets a retrospective split into substrate faults and work-agent quality faults with evidence pointers and existing-issue links.
narratives.Proposal: Add a 'Pipeline retrospective' button to the Command Deck header row (next to the New-conversation plus button) with a two-item window menu (Last 24 hours default, Last 7 days). It POSTs { window, model, harness } to a new endpoint POST /api/conversations/retrospective (new route file). The server reads a new kickoff template roles/retrospective.md from disk on every request (so it can be tuned with no build or restart, exactly like roles/handoff.md), strips its frontmatter, renders the window bounds, OVERDECK_HOME, and per-project state/repo paths, and delegates to the existing conversation write door handleConversationCreate with no projectKey, producing an unscoped conversation that lands in the No-project bucket. The frontend then hard-navigates to /conv/<name>. The template mandates read-only behavior (forbidden pan/gh/git verbs listed), names every input source (records, review syntheses, feedback files, deacon and lifecycle logs, CI runs, issues filed in the window), and prescribes the four-section output shape; a prompt-invariant test pins the read-only clause and placeholders. PRD: .pan/drafts/PAN-3841.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No pan retrospective CLI verb and no new skill; pan-recap is unchanged.
- No tool-level sandboxing of the conversation; read-only is enforced by the prompt and pinned by a test only.
- No button inside the No-project overview (ProjectHome) or the simple home.
- No windows other than 24h and 7d; no free-form date range.
- No persistence of the report outside the conversation transcript.
- No changes to TalkItThrough, to project-scoped conversation creation, or to routes/conversations.ts beyond the export keyword on conversationReadDependencies.
- No growth of routes/conversations.ts or src/lib/overdeck/conversation-runtime.ts (both at their file-size ratchet caps).

autoDecisions.summary: Template home is roles/retrospective.md, read from disk per request.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue requires tuning without a dashboard rebuild. src/lib/cloister/prompts/*.md are build-copied to dist/dashboard/prompts (package.json:95) and cached by renderPrompt; the TalkItThrough seed is inlined in the frontend bundle. roles/handoff.md is the existing request-time conversation kickoff template (summary-fork.ts:342), so the new template sits beside it.

autoDecisions.summary: Button placement is the Command Deck header row, not the No-project overview.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue offers either. The sidebar's No-project bucket renders only once an unscoped conversation exists (Sidebar.tsx:247-250, :748), so a button living only in that deck is unreachable on a fresh install; the header row is always rendered.

autoDecisions.summary: Window selector is a two-item menu on the button (Last 24 hours default, Last 7 days).
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue asks for a 24h default with a 7-day selector; a menu fits the narrow header row and mirrors the existing ActionDock overflow pattern.

autoDecisions.summary: New endpoint POST /api/conversations/retrospective in a new route file delegating to handleConversationCreate.
autoDecisions.rationale: Keeps the single conversation write door, keeps the prompt server-side, and avoids growing routes/conversations.ts (1070/1070) and conversation-runtime.ts (1163/1163), both at their ratchet caps.

autoDecisions.summary: Model and harness come from the Command Deck sidebar picker; no server default model.
autoDecisions.rationale: Same source as the adjacent New-conversation button; the repo forbids hardcoded model fallbacks.

autoDecisions.summary: Read-only is a prompt contract pinned by a prompt-invariant test.
autoDecisions.rationale: Conversations have no per-conversation tool allowlist (conversation-runtime.ts:562); the invariant test is the mechanical guard that survives template tuning.

items.title: Add roles/retrospective.md kickoff template

narrative.Action: Create roles/retrospective.md exactly as specified in PRD work item WI-1: YAML frontmatter (name: retrospective, description), a first body line 'Pipeline retrospective: {{WINDOW_LABEL}}', a '## Ground rules (read-only)' section listing the forbidden pan, gh, git, and HTTP-write verbs, an '## Inputs' section using {{OVERDECK_HOME}}, {{WINDOW_START}}, {{WINDOW_END}}, and {{PROJECT_LINES}} that names records (migrated root/records vs legacy root/.pan/records), review syntheses, feedback files, the deacon log with a timestamp filter, lifecycle logs, CI runs, and issues filed in the window (labels pipeline, blocks-main, bug), and an '## Output shape' section with the four numbered sections (Headline; Pipeline and substrate faults; Work-agent quality faults; Recommended follow-ups). Use only the five placeholders named. Never place the word 'commit' within 40 characters of '.pan/' (scripts/lint-skills.sh:269). Commit this file alone with a 'Prompt-Change: new read-only pipeline retrospective kickoff template' trailer.

metadata.sizeJustification: One vertical slice: a kickoff template (roles/), the lib renderer/handler and route that serve it (src/lib, src/dashboard/server), the button that calls it (src/dashboard/frontend), a prompt-invariant test (tests/), the file-size allowlist (scripts/) only as a contingency, and docs. Sibling issues would ship a button with no endpoint or an endpoint with no template; 15 files across 7 top-level directories is the minimum surface for the feature to be observable end to end.
